sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We highly value our 12-year partnership and are pleased to support your request for a 24-month contract to ensure mutual planning security. However, extending the payment terms to 60 days places an undue burden on our operations, so we propose a fair compromise of 45 days. 

Reflecting this commitment and the extended contract duration, we can revise our offer to a price of €51.60 per unit. Our current offer stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €51.40 per unit. As another option, we offer a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In the spirit of our 12-year partnership, we are taking a step to €51.30, but we must see a genuine concession from your side to proceed. 

Our current proposal stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

We rely on mutual fairness to maintain the high quality and reliability you expect from our foundry. As a traditional family-run business, we take immense pride in the craftsmanship of our people and the long-standing relationships we have built in our region. We value our shared history with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH deeply and trust that we can find a balanced path forward together that respects the dedication poured into every casting we produce for you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Our longstanding connection to your company means a great deal to our family foundry, and we always strive to work together in good faith. In that spirit, we have already accommodated your request for a delayed effective date of April 2027 and made a significant step to €51.10. 

As there is no movement forward from your side, we must maintain our current offer. For clarity, our offer stands at a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We hope these terms allow us to continue our valued partnership and look forward to hearing from you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We note that your proposal remains unchanged from the previous round. Having already accommodated your request for a delayed effective date of April 2027, we have reached the absolute limit of what is economically viable for our family foundry.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our submission stands at a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Our family business takes great pride in the castings we produce and the long relationship we have shared with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. However, to maintain the high standards and craftsmanship our region is known for, we must remain on solid financial ground. We hope you understand our position and look forward to your decision.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

decisions.tactician: Of all the options, o1 at its health price gives our lowest C, €404,697, slightly below E0's €405,052. E0 holds today's price, while o1 offers a small increase, which fits a stabilise goal and avoids the relationship charge. The 24-month term matters a great deal (the 12-month options cost about €29k more), and it is also something the supplier may value beyond the cash model. Pay 60 d is our reference term. Opening at health leaves room to concede towards midway if needed, since the supplier is not at final_offer.

decisions.tactician: o4 gives the supplier things the cash model does not count: a two-year commitment and a deferred effective date. Its its_level of €51.60 is above its current sheet, so its midway of €50.09 lands at C €411,003, close to the other midway rungs. It also hands the supplier the visible 'concession' it asked for: a price move from us plus a later start and faster pay. That makes acceptance or a further step likely while we keep 8 messages in reserve. E0 (€49.53 at C €407,407) is lower on paper but is only a price move on the same terms, and the supplier has explicitly demanded a concession. Health rungs near €48.58 sit about 5 % below the supplier's own sheet against its slowing pace, so it would likely reject them. Accepting DEMO-F1-2 now leaves about €10k of cost on the table. No arguments are left to cite.

decisions.tactician: It stalled at €51.10 partly because our last counter dropped; signalling a steady, reasoned position on its own preferred terms (o4) without retreating invites a move. Midway €49.84 matches our last sheet price—so it is effectively a firm restatement on identical terms, not a further concession, yet cheaper for us than E0 (€50.22) and far below accepting (€417,788). Health €48.58 would read as moving backward and harden it; E0 concedes €0.38 for nothing. With six messages left, firmness now preserves room to step up later if needed.

why.tactician: The supplier holds a final offer and has stopped conceding, so further counters gain nothing and risk losing the deal, which would score zero. Accepting gives C €417,788, about €31k below C_open. E0 and the other options' midway or health rungs would mean going below a final offer it has repeated three times. Their its_level rungs barely differ in C (o4 is identical to this sheet), so countering cannot improve on accepting now.
